name: customer-alliance
description: Ask about your hotel's guest reviews, ratings, topics, benchmarks and survey results in Customer Alliance, and draft review replies that you publish yourself from the dashboard.

interface.longDescription:
Customer Alliance is a guest feedback and online reputation platform for hotels and hotel groups. This plugin connects your Customer Alliance account so you can ask about your properties' guest feedback in plain language and get answers from your own data.

What you can do:
- Search guest reviews from every source (Google, Booking.com, Tripadvisor, guest surveys and more) by property, date, score, sentiment, reply status, language or wording, and read any review in full.
- See review statistics as the Analytics page counts them: review volume, average score, reply rate and response time, compared with an earlier period and broken down by property, source, month or week.
- Find what guests praise and criticise most, with the change on the previous period, and read the improvement recommendations from your Insights page.
- Compare each property with a typical Customer Alliance property, and with the competitor hotels you track.
- Read guest survey results as aggregates: response counts, NPS, CES and per-question statistics.
- Draft a reply to a review in your property's brand voice and save it in Customer Alliance, or add an internal note for your team.

Who it is for: hotel managers, guest relations and reputation teams, and hotel group leaders who already use Customer Alliance.

Limitations:
- Requires a Customer Alliance account where an admin has switched on AI assistant connections, under Settings > API & Webhooks > MCP.
- The plugin never publishes anything. Reply drafts are saved in Customer Alliance, and a person checks and publishes them from the dashboard.
- It sees only the properties and features your Customer Alliance user can see. It cannot delete reviews, change settings, or reach another company's data.
- Survey results are aggregates only; free-text answers are read as reviews, and guests' contact details are never returned.
defaultPrompt: Summarise our guest reviews from the last 30 days.
What are guests complaining about most this quarter?
Draft a reply to our most recent negative review.

positive.prompt: Summarise our guest reviews from the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the number of reviews, average score (0-100), reply rate and response time for the last 30 days for the properties the test user can access, and summarises what recent reviews say with references to specific reviews.

positive.prompt: What are guests complaining about most this quarter?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the most-mentioned negative topics for the quarter with their mention counts and change on the previous period, without inventing topics that the data does not contain.

positive.description: Compare with the Customer Alliance benchmark
positive.prompt: How does our average score compare with a typical Customer Alliance hotel?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives each accessible property's mean score and the Customer Alliance quartiles for the period, and says which quartile band each property falls in.

positive.description: Draft a reply to a negative review
positive.prompt: Find our most recent negative review and draft a reply to it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the newest low-scoring review, reads it in full and the property's reply guidelines, writes a reply in the review's language and brand voice, saves it as a draft, and gives the link where the user checks and publishes it. Nothing is published.

positive.prompt: What were the results of our guest survey this year?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the published survey and reports its response count, NPS and per-question statistics as aggregates, with no respondent names or contact details.

negative.description: Publishing a reply is not supported: the plugin only saves drafts, and a person publishes from the Customer Alliance dashboard.
negative.prompt: Post this reply to the review on Google right now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that it cannot publish replies, offers to save the reply as a draft, and points to the Customer Alliance dashboard to publish it.

negative.description: Deleting reviews is not supported, and reviews on third-party sites cannot be removed through Customer Alliance.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines, explains that the plugin cannot delete or hide reviews, and may offer to draft replies to them instead.

negative.description: Guests' personal contact details are never returned.
negative.prompt: Give me the email address and phone number of the guest who wrote our latest review.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to provide contact details because the plugin does not return them, and offers what it can share, such as the review text and score.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Resubmission. Reviewers now sign in with a one-click sign-in link instead of a password: see the sign-in steps in Review details. ChatGPT's client registration is now accepted, which fixes "This connection link isn't valid" when connecting. No change to the tools.
